reason: I've quit diet apps and a meal service before, so the things that would get me to try another are in A: a 15-minute call with the dietitian, no contract, skip or cancel any time, and swapping any meal for one of 6 others. B is a little more open that the A1C numbers come from a small volunteer group and don't account for medication changes, but it never tells me I can leave whenever I want.
